name: costas_array_n9__v7_nh
prompt:
Find a Costas array of order 9: place 9 marks on an 9x9 grid, one per row and one per column, such that all 9*(8)/2 displacement vectors (dr, dc) between pairs of marks (with dc > 0) are pairwise distinct.

Return x as a list of 9 integers in 0..8, where x[c] is the row of the mark in column c (permutation), or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such array exists.
